voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In October two thousand nine, Bobby and Sherilynn Jamison and their six-year-old daughter, Madyson, drove into the hills of southeastern Oklahoma to look at land.
Days later, their pickup was found, abandoned, near the land.
Inside were their wallets, their phones, about thirty-two thousand dollars in cash. And their dog, malnourished.
Four years later, hunters found their remains, less than three miles away.
No cause of death was ever determined.
